reviews.author: Dustin Sims
reviews.text: I needed a second upstream o2 sensor bung welded on to one of my exhaust pipes so that I could run an aftermarket Air/Fuel gauge. Im not a welder and not the most familiar with it, so I went to Gur's. They had a very fast turnover at about 14 hours from the time I dropped off the exhaust pipe (I had already removed it from the vehicle I'm working on, so no labor charge or time. Also, I supplied the weldeable bung and marked a large area that would be acceptable for the weld) to the time they called for pick up. The cost was 70$ with a military discount. I wasn't very impressed with the work as I felt that it should have been cleaned up more. There were still shavings from the hole being drilled that were poking through the weld, and I was pretty disappointed when I got home and noticed that some of the welding rod had dripped down into my catalytic converter. Pictures posted of the work done.

reviews.author: Treasure
reviews.text: Avoid this place by any means!!! I had my vehicle towed and repaired by this place and they did a patch up job and charged me top dollar for parts and labor work that was not done properly. They used zip ties to secure my fan assy and charged me for replacing it. They also used incorrect parts on my engine and caused it to malfunction a day after pickup. I had to pay a Real auto shop to do the job correctly. When they were confronted about they're sloppy work they were not accountable at all. Had to file a civil suit against Mr.Gur after he had no real excuse for these findings. This place is worst than a shade tree mechanic. If you care about your vehicle avoid this junkyard.

reviews.author: Nick Johnson
reviews.text: Car died while on the way to work and barely made it to Gur’s. They were able to squeeze me in that day and replaced the alternator within a few hours. Fair price for the job. Consider them for any repairs!

reviews.author: tara krieger
reviews.text: Don't use this company! They charged me 250$ to tow our car about 5 miles! They average towing cost is about 75$ but since the call came from the police they automatically charge 250$ no matter what. My son is 16 and was in his 1st accident and did not realized we had road side assistance. The police called this company and had the tow truck sent. When I asked why they would charge this much the reply was " it a an automatic 250.00$ charge when the call comes in from the police". Draw your own conclusions but this seems like a scam!!!! why would you take advantage of a person in a stressful situation just becaise the police called it in! They were very rude over the phone when I called about the price a d refused to negotiate. I will also be calling the police to know why they are using such an outrageous company that charge 3x the regular rate!

reviews.author: Jerome Curry
reviews.text: Gur’s automotive center is the best called in for a tow they were there no longer than 15 minutes and had my car back up and running within 1 hours definitely would recommend and prices are very very reasonable.

reviews.author: Lucy Roberts
reviews.text: This is the 3rd time I've had to use ger towing and they have always been very prompt and professional thank you very much for saving me off the side of the road.

reviews.text: I love them always great conversations, laughs and outstanding service. You should definitely give them a shot
